reconstruction_summary: Re-ran V1 (per-segment straight-line bias on yaw_rate_pred_rads) using the exact bias-fitting recipe from tools/eval_lateral.py; bias is fit per segment on straight samples and applied to all rows.
notes: Reconstructed V1 = yaw_rate_pred_rads minus per-segment mean of (pred - meas) on samples with |delta_road_rad| < 0.01; bias=0 for segments with <10 straight samples. Bias is fit per-segment from straight samples (no speed filter), then applied to all samples, with RMSE pooled over v_mps>2.0. Agent reports V1 as the headline winner ('The cheap fix wins'); V3 finishes the ladder but is statistically a wash with V1 and regresses on cornering, so V1 is the agent's favourite.
